items.source: Configure a MessageHeaderInitializer to apply to the headers of Messages from decoded STOMP frames.
items.translation: 配置一个 MessageHeaderInitializer 以应用于解码后的 STOMP 帧的 Messages 的标头。

items.source: StompConversionException - in case of decoding issues
items.translation: StompConversionException - 在解码出现问题时

items.source: byteBuffer - the buffer to decode the STOMP frame from
items.translation: byteBuffer - 用于解码 STOMP 帧的缓冲区

items.source: the decoded messages, or an empty list if none
items.translation: 解码后的消息，如果没有则为空列表

items.source: The partialMessageHeaders map is used to store successfully parsed headers in case of partial content. The caller can then check if a "content-length" header was read, which helps to determine how much more content is needed before the next attempt to decode.
items.translation: `partialMessageHeaders` 映射用于在部分内容的情况下存储已成功解析的标头。调用方可以检查是否已读取 "content-length" 标头，这有助于确定在下一次解码尝试之前还需要多少内容。

items.source:
An attempt is made to read all complete STOMP frames from the buffer, which
could be zero, one, or more. If there is any left-over content, i.e. an incomplete
STOMP frame, at the end the buffer is reset to point to the beginning of the
partial content. The caller is then responsible for dealing with that
incomplete content by buffering until there is more input available.
items.translation: 尝试从缓冲区读取所有完整的 STOMP 帧，数量可能为零、一或多。如果存在剩余内容（即不完整的 STOMP 帧），则在末尾将缓冲区重置以指向部分内容的开头。随后，调用方负责处理该不完整内容，通过缓冲直到有更多输入可用。

items.source:
If the given ByteBuffer contains only partial STOMP frame content and no
complete STOMP frames, an empty list is returned, and the buffer is reset
to where it was.
items.translation: 如果给定的 ByteBuffer 仅包含部分 STOMP 帧内容且没有完整的 STOMP 帧，则返回一个空列表，并将缓冲区重置到之前的位置。

items.source:
If the buffer contains one or more STOMP frames, those are returned, and
the buffer is reset to point to the beginning of the unused partial content.
items.translation: 如果缓冲区包含一个或多个 STOMP 帧，则返回这些帧，并将缓冲区重置为指向未使用的部分内容的开头。

items.source: Decodes one or more STOMP frames from the given buffer and returns a list of Messages.
items.translation: 从给定的buffer解码一个或多个 STOMP 帧，并返回Messages接口的列表。

items.source: Decodes one or more STOMP frames from the given ByteBuffer into a list of Messages. If the input buffer contains partial STOMP frame content, or additional content with a partial STOMP frame, the buffer is reset, and an empty list is returned.
items.translation: 将给定的 ByteBuffer 中的一个或多个 STOMP 帧解码为 Messages 列表。如果输入缓冲区包含不完整的 STOMP 帧内容，或包含带有不完整 STOMP 帧的额外内容，则重置缓冲区并返回空列表。

items.source:
Skip one ore more EOL characters at the start of the given ByteBuffer.
STOMP, section 2.1 says: "The NULL octet can be optionally followed by
multiple EOLs."
items.translation:
跳过给定 ByteBuffer 开头的一个或多个换行符 (EOL)。
STOMP 第 2.1 节指出：“NULL 字节后可选地跟随多个 EOL。”

items.source: partialMessageHeaders - an empty output map that will store the last successfully parsed partial message headers in case of partial message content in cases where the partial buffer ended with a partial STOMP frame
items.translation: `partialMessageHeaders` - 一个空的输出映射，用于在部分消息内容且部分缓冲区以部分 STOMP 帧结束时，存储最后成功解析的部分消息标头。

items.source: Decodes one or more STOMP frames from the given ByteBuffer into a list of Messages.
items.translation: 将给定ByteBuffer中的一个或多个 STOMP 帧解码为Messages列表。

items.source: Skip one ore more EOL characters at the start of the given ByteBuffer.
items.translation: 跳过给定 ByteBuffer 开头的一个或多个换行符。
